Name: True God Mode (And More) (1.6.14)
Author: WingleWanger
Description:
[center][size=6][b]FREE SHOPPING CURRENTLY BREAKS MINECART TRAVEL.[/b]
Until I'm able to fix this, be sure  to just quickly disable free shopping before using a mine cart.




[b]To track updates, check the Changelogs section.[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=6][b]To request features, go to "Posts"[/b][/size][/center]

[b][size=3]Current Features[/size][/b]

[b]- God Mode: [/b] The player takes no damage and can't be debuffed [b](Toggled on by default)
[/b]
[b]- Infinite Energy: [/b]The player can't have their energy drained from tool use or negative energy foods [b](Toggled off by default)
[/b]
[b]- Instant Bite: [/b]No more waiting for fish to bite after a cast [b](Toggled off by default)
[/b]
[b]- Free Shopping: [/b]The player can make any and all shop purchases for free, [b]even for items they can't even afford yet.[/b] Covers all shop menus, dialogue options,  house renovations, house upgrades, tool upgrades, building construction, and animal purchases. [b]Works with all currencies.[/b] [b](Toggled off by default)
[/b]
[b]- Free Crafting: [/b]The player can craft any recipe they know for free, even without the proper ingredients on hand. Covers the inventory crafting menu and the stove, probably more I haven't been able to test. [b](Toggled off by default)
[/b]
[b]- GMCM Configuration: [/b]Toggle any of the options on and off whenever you feel like, and choose your own keybinds to do so


[b][size=3]Install/Uninstall/Update 
[/size][/b]- you can install the mod by just dragging it into your stardew valley mods file.

- to update the mod, just delete the older version from your mods folder, and redownload the newest version.

- you can remove the mod safely anytime by just removing the TrueGodMode folder from your mods folder.

[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/b]

This mod should be compatible with any mod that doesn't directly change something similar. With that being said, even if one of my features is incompatible with something, you can just choose to turn that option off and all should be fine.
